{"notes": "Visit 4 (left at 6:15). Nobody spoke while I was there, and I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm crediting only what people said and what the picture shows.

State of the build: the outline is closed and continuous from the start through the top line, belly and rounded tail. Two issues are unchanged since visit 3: one pale, unconnected domino at the top-line dip near (20.3, 7.8), and a crowded, possibly doubled-up tail/belly join around x 23-26, y 13.3. Both are risks for the push, though the pale stray is harmless to the chain if it stays disconnected. No one's hands were shown on the picture, so the team seems to be holding to hands off.

Sofia: Not seen or heard. Jack credits her with the tail, which fits her plan. Her visit 2 promise to inspect the join is still not visibly paid off. Collaboration and communication strong, execution good but not perfect.

Omar: Not seen or heard. He cleared strays at the dip earlier, yet one remains. I can't tell whether he ran out of time or missed it. Visit 2 ownership stands. Ask him in the review.

Hana: Not seen or heard. Her 'hands off until the push' call was sensible, but her 'looks solid' missed the stray and the crowded join. Still no direct evidence of her building. Visit 1 leadership stands.

Jack: Not seen or heard. Earlier he was gracious, credited others, and kept hands off. Still no evidence of what he built. Ask him directly. Collaboration positive, impact and execution unknown.

For the review: don't rate anyone on the final push result alone, since I can't attribute the outcome to individuals."}
